candidates.reason: Rearranged properly into a left-to-right banner with even spacing, but the doodle frame has shrunk to a muddy, unreadable smudge that looks like a rendering error. 'Dear Teachers!' sits apart from the headline it introduces, and 'Santa Gloria High School' is tiny and faint.

The whole poster has been shrunk into a tiny column in the middle of the banner, with about 90% of the canvas left empty. Apart from the headline, all text is unreadable, and the doodle frame cannot be seen.

The doodle pattern is cropped hard against the left edge and reads as a broken fragment. The text is packed into a tight centre-right cluster with dead navy space to its left, so the layout is lopsided. 'Dear Teachers!' is jammed under the title, and the footer text is small.

The doodle sits as a busy pattern directly behind 'Dear Teachers!' and the left edge of 'WE LOVE YOU!', which breaks the rule that text never sits on a busy image. All the content is crammed into the centre, leaving empty strips on the left and right.
